title: NASA operator disconnects Gary during hack

tellings.quote: obviously when that guy right clicked the LAN icon and disconnected me, that was NAZA.

plain: Gary McKinnon, a British computer hacker, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that around 2001 and 2002 he broke into computers belonging to NASA, the US space agency, from his home in the UK over a British Telecom line. He says that at one point someone on the other end noticed him, right clicked the network icon on screen and cut him off, and that this was NASA itself. He tells it as part of his claim that he found signs of a secret space program.
